text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dad... Dad collapsed...?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Pushing herself so hard in secret...
How could this be...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "So, where is Dad now!? The hospital, right? Okay, got it!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Kyoto to Fuchu. And then back to Osaka.
I ended up on a whirlwind round-trip journey
with Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Tama-nee-nee... Is Pops gonna be okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no worries at all. The doc said
I'll be right as rain with a little rest."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from stopping by the hospital, I came to Tamamo Cross's family home.
There was a slight lie in Tamamo Cross's explanation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"'There is no danger to her life, but she needs complete rest for a while.
There is no telling when she will recover' was the doctor's prognosis."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Don't you worry, just go play.
Big sis will take care of everything."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross soothes her younger siblings.
From her expression...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The usual rough-and-tumble vibe vanished, gradually giving way to a gentle expression.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, and sorry for dragging you along
for dinner shopping too. That should do it.
choice_data_list: Tamamo, I need to talk to you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Talk...? What about?
choice_data_list: Are you planning to quit the race?
Are you thinking of quitting the race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...!? Why are you looking like that...?
choice_data_list: I can tell just by looking at your face
I can tell just by looking at your face

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Geez, I really can't beat ya, can I?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Someone's gotta be at home, right?
Not knowin' what's gonna happen to Dad an' all."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I'm running for my family's sake...
If there's something more urgent than racing, then I've got no choice, do I...?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring)... I managed to do at least one dutiful thing for my parents.
In that case...
choice_data_list: If you quit, won't you regret it?
Won't you regret it if you quit?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't think I will. It's a shame
I couldn't conquer the Twinkle Series, but..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I gave it everything I had.
I've got no regrets. No regrets...
at all..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why... Why did ya have to...
Nah, forget it. It's nothin' around here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross cut off her lingering thoughts and gave her report to her family the next morning while visiting them.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Mother
text_block_list.text:
So Tama... are you sayin'
you're quittin' racing?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. I gotta look after Dad who can't move for a while
and the little ones. I've got no business runnin' right now."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I gotta... I gotta support 'em...
My family comes first! That's why...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, ya got a sec?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one speaking to me was my father in his hospital bed.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: What's next for Tama...? Is it gonna get real tough from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
People used to say all sorts of things to me.
"Poor kids can't run." "Frail kids can't run."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Still, we've always believed in Tama.
How does it look through your eyes?
Is this really as far as she goes?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looking into her eyes, I realized.
What she needed wasn't polite, empty comfort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I must squeeze out my absolute best efforts to give
Tamamo Cross an unvarnished assessment and outlook.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her family's future hangs on that decision.
From what I've seen, Tamamo Cross's past and future are—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm gonna eat properly.
Even if it's little by little, I'll eat.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... that's right...
My real weapon is... a flash of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: This is the new "White Lightning"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I remember... the path of lightning... The White Lightning
has crawled along the earth, sprinting all this time.
And from here on—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was certain. As long as she possessed this sheer grit
and such a magnificent heart—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Because I can win! From here on out, without fail!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Well, that's fine then.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Tama, now ain't the time to be coming back home.
Run, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Dad...!!
I'm doing this for our family—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Running is for your family's sake!
That's what matters most!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Those words were filled with strong emotion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
You probably don't know.
Just how overjoyed your family was whenever you ran in a race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
You have no idea how happy I was.
Seeing you, who loved running ever since you were little,
looking so full of life like that...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day you were born...
My wife and I have been waiting for a day like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
She's our hope. The hope for all of us
who weren't blessed with fortune. I know she'll find happiness
and shine a light upon us all...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there've been hard times. And there might
be more to come. But you know what...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
As long as you ran with all your heart,
it'd all just blow away. Everything was blown away.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Supporting the family through running ain't the hope.
Just running is hope! That alone is hope itself!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Dad...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
...If she quits after seeing it through to the end, that's fine.
But if she's made to quit halfway for our sake,
then what was all her hard work for?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Run, Tama!
All our dreams—I've placed them all on you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: That's right, Tama-nee! Run for us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross's younger brother followed suit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
I love watchin' Tama-nee-nee run!
Way more than when she stays home and plays with me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Hearing about races is so fun!
And the photos you send too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Tama... Things back home will work out fine.
So... please run.
Give your pops some strength.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Mother
text_block_list.text:
To this person, you're—
everything.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Mom... Dad... You guys...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's how it was.
Just me runnin' itself is... hope...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Then... Then I'll show 'em what I'm made of!
I'm gonna run. And I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The next Takarazuka Kinen! So Daddy, you've gotta beat your illness! And you little ones, hang in there and don't be lonely!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll take the lead! So, that's why
we're definitely gonna win! Let's do this, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah... Big Sis Tama!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Voices united as a family echo in the Osaka hospital.
A conclusion has been reached.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross will keep on running.
Together as one with her family.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: We're finally back... in Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I wouldn't have any regrets even if I quit. That's
how I genuinely felt. I gave it my absolute all in my own way.
But..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Even so... there was still a tiny spark
inside me that just wouldn't die out."
choice_data_list: Are those sparks of fighting spirit?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No. It's close, but slightly different.
What I just couldn't manage to shake was...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome back, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri...
You came all the way out here just to meet me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Um, I hesitated, but...
I still really wanted to come.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I just had this feeling you might not come back.
Um... well... Welcome home, Tama."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I already told ya that just a second ago.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (Oguri... why? Why is it like this...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(You're definitely a lot like me.
GROWING up in the country, you weren't blessed from the start either. But...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Why did your face pop into my head back then?
Right when I was on the brink of retiring, at the most crucial moment.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(What's buggin' her so much?
I don't really get it... but...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' at your face like this... it reminded me.
There's no way in hell I'd ever ditch you
and go somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Tamamo Cross looked at Oguri Cap,
many different emotions flickered across her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, the Takarazuka Kinen! 
I'll show ya right there, Oguri.
I'll show ya how I run with nothin' holdin' me back!
